match_stages.stage_briefing:
Stage 1 is a 28 round, 140 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing with hands touching marks, handgun loaded and holstered. 

PCC: Standing with PCC muzzle touching mark, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 4 is a 30 round, 150 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing with hands touching marks, handgun loaded and holstered. 

PCC: Standing with PCC muzzle touching marks, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 5 is a 25 round, 135 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing completely outside the shooting area with toes touching marks, handgun loaded and holstered. 

PCC: Standing completely outside the shooting area with toes touching marks, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 6 is a 28 round, 140 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing on start stick with wrists above shoulders, handgun UNLOADED and holstered.

PCC: Standing on start stick with wrists above shoulders, PCC UNLOADED.


Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 7 is a 16 round, 80 point fixed time course of fire with a 5.2 second par time. The start position is Standing inside the shooting area with heels on marks, handgun loaded and holstered. Any shots over 5.50 are considered overtime.

PCC: Standing inside the shooting area with heels on marks, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 8 is a 32 round, 160 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing inside the shooting area with toes touching marks, handgun loaded and holstered. 

PCC: Standing inside the shooting area with toes touching marks, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 19 is a 26 round, 130 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing anywhere inside the shooting area, handgun loaded and holstered. 

PCC: Standing anywhere inside the shooting area, PCC loaded with safety on. 

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

BEST 2 HITS PER PAPER will score!

Stage 10 is a 15 round, 65 point comstock course of fire. The start position is Standing on start stick, handgun loaded and holstered. 
PCC: Standing on start stick, PCC loaded with safety on. 
Stomp pad is not a part of the shooting area.

Upon start signal engage targets from within the shooting area. 

Stomp pad activates T1 (drop turner); BEST  6 HITS  on T1 will score.
Popper activates T2 (swinger) the BEST 2 HITS on T2 will score.
